scenes.title: Not Like History
scenes.summary: Epic plots must be dramatic and whole, not like histories that tell one period of time: the sea battle at Salamis and the battle with the Carthaginians in Sicily fell at the same time with no single end.

scenes.title: Homer Divine
scenes.summary: Homer did not try to tell the whole war, but took one part and used others as episodes, like the Catalogue of Ships.

scenes.title: The Cypria and the Little Iliad
scenes.summary: The other poets write of one man or one period, like the poets of the Cypria and the Little Iliad, which yield many tragedies, while the Iliad and the Odyssey yield one or two.
